title: G-Cloud 14 for clinical AI: how NHS Trusts deploy SEWA in under 5 business days
subtitle: No competitive tender required — here is how the procurement route works
excerpt: NHS Trusts can deploy SEWA AI under G-Cloud 14 without a competitive tender, in under 5 business days. This post explains exactly how the route works, what it means for procurement teams, and what to check before signing.
content:
What G-Cloud 14 means for NHS procurement

NHS Trusts can deploy SEWA AI under G-Cloud 14 without a competitive tender, in under 5 business days. For procurement teams navigating tight timelines and mounting clinical backlogs, this is not a technical detail — it is the difference between adopting AI this year and waiting another procurement cycle.

G-Cloud 14 is the UK government's digital marketplace framework, enabling public-sector organisations to procure cloud-based services from pre-approved suppliers. Being listed means SEWA has been assessed against the government's procurement and security standards, reducing the due-diligence burden on individual NHS Trusts.
author: Dolapo Ariyo
